questions.text: What value, and what allowed range, should parameter CLKS_PER_BIT of c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top have?
questions.reason: The specification provides the parameter name and baud rate but not its default; 868 is the nearest integer number of 100 MHz clocks per 115200-baud bit.

questions.text: What value, and what allowed range, should parameter TIMEOUT_CYCLES of c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top have?
questions.reason: The specification provides the parameter name but not a default; 100000000 cycles is a proposed one-second timeout at 100 MHz.
questions.answer: TIMEOUT_CYCLES is 100000; its allowed range is not specified.

questions.text: At which offset of the shell's register window do audio_state's registers start?
questions.reason: The shell window occupies 0x80-0xFF; window_base 0x00 places the aligned offsets 0x00, 0x04, and 0x08 at physical addresses 0x80, 0x84, and 0x88.
questions.answer:
SAMPLE: offset 0x00, RW, reset 0: [15:0] audio sample, two's complement; [31:16] read 0
GAIN: offset 0x01, WO, reset 0: [15:0] a write sets the gain register (values above 8192 give 8192); the register cannot be read back; reads 0
SOUT: offset 0x02, RO, reset 0: [15:0] sample_out = sample after the gain, two's complement; [31:16] read 0
